value.rationale: A complete uniform classification of the reduced codimension-one singular locus of naturally motivated three-variable Lissajous surfaces, including two distinct branch mechanisms and a sharp normalization phase transition, addresses a gap explicitly left by the recent singularity analysis for three-coordinate hypersurfaces. It is an infinite nontrivial natural family with unbounded singular-component count, not a routine example.
